tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The findings of a finished scan: each problem with its severity, explanation, evidence and how to fix it. Optionally limited to one category (performance, seo, geo for AI search, best_practices, accessibility).

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Status of a scan by id; once finished, the same summary as scan_url (scores, metrics, top fixes, AI crawler access).

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Sites the team monitors (paid plans), with latest homepage scores, open alerts and whether Search Console and IndexNow are set up.

tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Scan a public web page for performance (Core Web Vitals), SEO and AI-search readiness, on mobile and desktop. Waits up to about 100 seconds; if the scan isn't finished by then, returns its scan_id to check with get_scan. Returns scores, key metrics, the top fixes and whether AI crawlers can access t

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: One monitored site in detail: tracked pages with their latest scores, open alerts, and auto-indexing status.
